company_name: Taiwan Carrier Tape Enterprise Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiwan Carrier Tape Enterprise Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing carrier tapes essential for the packaging and handling of semiconductor components.
summary: Taiwan Carrier Tape Enterprise Co., Ltd. (TCTEC) is a leading manufacturer of high-precision plastic carrier tapes, cover tapes, and plastic reels, primarily serving the semiconductor industry. With a strong focus on R&D and in-house tooling capabilities, TCTEC provides tailored solutions that meet diverse customer requirements in component packaging.

regional_presence.Taiwan: TCTEC is recognized as the top carrier tape manufacturer in Taiwan, with a strong reputation in the local and global markets.
